description: This file defines a Flutter widget called BoardView, which renders a chessboard UI. It displays the board with pieces, handles visual highlighting of selected squares, responsiveness, and interactions such as tapping squares.

classes.name: BoardView
classes.description: A stateless widget that visualizes a chessboard, displaying pieces, highlighted selected squares, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI for the chessboard, creating an 8x8 grid with alternating colors, piece icons, and interaction handlers.

methods.name: _blend
methods.description: Helper method to blend two colors with alpha transparency, used for hover/highlight effects on squares.
